text:
Anhydrous copper(II) sulfate and anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride change colour when water is
added to them.
Which row shows the correct colour changes?
copper(II) sulfate
cobalt(II) chloride
A
blue to white
blue to pink
B
blue to white
pink to blue
C
white to blue
blue to pink
D
white to blue
pink to blue
